shortDescription: create, update, or destroy Automation Platform Controller job templates.

options.name: allow_simultaneous
options.description: Allow simultaneous runs of the job template.

options.name: ask_credential_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for credential on launch.

options.name: ask_diff_mode_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user to enable diff mode (show changes) to files when supported by modules.

options.name: ask_execution_environment_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for execution environment on launch.

options.name: ask_forks_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for forks on launch.

options.name: ask_instance_groups_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for instance groups on launch.

options.name: ask_inventory_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for inventory on launch.

options.name: ask_job_slice_count_on_launch
options.displayName: Ask Job Slice Count On Launch
options.description: Prompt user for job slice count on launch.

options.name: ask_job_type_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for job type on launch.

options.name: ask_labels_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for labels on launch.

options.name: ask_limit_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for a limit on launch.

options.name: ask_scm_branch_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for (scm branch) on launch.

options.name: ask_skip_tags_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for job tags to skip on launch.

options.name: ask_tags_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for job tags on launch.

options.name: ask_timeout_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for timeout on launch.

options.name: ask_variables_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user for (extra_vars) on launch.

options.name: ask_verbosity_on_launch
options.description: Prompt user to choose a verbosity level on launch.

options.name: become_enabled
options.description: Activate privilege escalation.

options.name: controller_config_file
options.description: Path to the controller config file. If provided, the other locations for config files will not be considered.

options.name: controller_host
options.description: URL to your Automation Platform Controller instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_HOST) and then config files If value not specified by any means, the value of C(127.0.0.1) will be used

options.name: controller_oauthtoken
options.description: The OAuth token to use. This value can be in one of two formats. A string which is the token itself. (i.e. bqV5txm97wqJqtkxlMkhQz0pKhRMMX) A dictionary structure as returned by the token module. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_OAUTH_TOKEN) and then config files

options.name: controller_password
options.description: Password for your controller instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_PASSWORD) and then config files

options.name: controller_username
options.description: Username for your controller instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_USERNAME) and then config files

options.name: copy_from
options.description: Name or id to copy the job template from. This will copy an existing job template and change any parameters supplied. The new job template name will be the one provided in the name parameter. The organization parameter is not used in this, to facilitate copy from one organization to another. Provide the id or use the lookup plugin to provide the id if multiple job templates share the same name.

options.name: credential
options.description: Name, ID, or named URL of the credential to use for the job template. Deprecated, use 'credentials'.

options.name: credentials
options.description: List of credential names, IDs, or named URLs to use for the job template.

options.name: custom_virtualenv
options.description: Local absolute file path containing a custom Python virtualenv to use. Only compatible with older versions of AWX/Tower Deprecated, will be removed in the future

options.name: description
options.description: Description to use for the job template.

options.name: diff_mode
options.description: Enable diff mode for the job template.

options.name: execution_environment
options.description: Execution Environment name, ID, or named URL to use for the job template.

options.name: extra_vars
options.description: Specify C(extra_vars) for the template.

options.name: force_handlers
options.description: Enable forcing playbook handlers to run even if a task fails.

options.name: forks
options.description: The number of parallel or simultaneous processes to use while executing the playbook.

options.name: host_config_key
options.description: Allow provisioning callbacks using this host config key.

options.name: instance_groups
options.description: list of Instance Group names, IDs, or named URLs for this Organization to run on.

options.name: inventory
options.description: Name, ID, or named URL of the inventory to use for the job template.

options.name: job_slice_count
options.description: The number of jobs to slice into at runtime. Will cause the Job Template to launch a workflow if value is greater than 1.

options.name: job_tags
options.description: Comma separated list of the tags to use for the job template.

options.name: job_type
options.description: The job type to use for the job template.

options.name: labels
options.description: The labels applied to this job template Must be created with the labels module first. This will error if the label has not been created.

options.name: limit
options.description: A host pattern to further constrain the list of hosts managed or affected by the playbook

options.name: name
options.description: Name to use for the job template.

options.name: new_name
options.description: Setting this option will change the existing name (looked up via the name field.

options.name: notification_templates_error
options.description: list of notifications to send on error

options.name: notification_templates_started
options.description: list of notifications to send on start

options.name: notification_templates_success
options.description: list of notifications to send on success

options.name: organization
options.description: Organization name, ID, or named URL the job template exists in. Used to help lookup the object, cannot be modified using this module. The Organization is inferred from the associated project If not provided, will lookup by name only, which does not work with duplicates. Requires Automation Platform Version 3.7.0 or AWX 10.0.0 IS NOT backwards compatible with earlier versions.

options.name: playbook
options.description: Path to the playbook to use for the job template within the project provided.

options.name: prevent_instance_group_fallback
options.description: Prevent falling back to instance groups set on the associated inventory or organization

options.name: project
options.description: Name, ID, or named URL of the project to use for the job template.

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: Specify the timeout Ansible should use in requests to the controller host. Defaults to 10s, but this is handled by the shared module_utils code

options.name: scm_branch
options.description: Branch to use in job run. Project default used if blank. Only allowed if project allow_override field is set to true.

options.name: skip_tags
options.description: Comma separated list of the tags to skip for the job template.

options.name: start_at_task
options.description: Start the playbook at the task matching this name.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the resource.

options.name: survey_enabled
options.description: Enable a survey on the job template.

options.name: survey_spec
options.description: JSON/YAML dict formatted survey definition.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a job to finish (server-side).

options.name: use_fact_cache
options.description: Enable use of fact caching for the job template.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to allow insecure connections to AWX. If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_VERIFY_SSL) and then config files

options.name: vault_credential
options.description: Name, ID, or named URL of the vault credential to use for the job template. Deprecated, use 'credentials'.

options.name: verbosity
options.description: Control the output level Ansible produces as the playbook runs. 0 - Normal, 1 - Verbose, 2 - More Verbose, 3 - Debug, 4 - Connection Debug.

options.name: webhook_credential
options.description: Personal Access Token for posting back the status to the service API

options.name: webhook_service
options.description: Service that webhook requests will be accepted from
